item.title: 40 Tons Of Trash Removed From Great Pacific Garbage Patch
item.description: An ocean clean up group recently removed 40 tons of trash from The Great Pacific Garbage Patch, however there is still a lot of work to be done.

item.title: Poachers Continue To Harm Turtles Protected By The Endangered Species Act
item.description: Harming turtles can incur steep penalties under the Endangered Species Act, but fines and jail time are not enough to deter Florida Poachers.

item.title: Study Shows How Environmental Protections Can Save The Great Barrier Reef
item.description: For years, the Great Barrier Reef has been steadily declining, but a recent study of the reef around One Tree Island proves that all hope is not lost

item.title: Researchers Investigate The Long Term Effects Of Coral Bleaching On Fish Populations
item.description: Coral bleaching can have long term effects on local fish populations; impacts that can continue to reverberate even after the coral bounces back.

item.title: Why Have Southern Resident Killer Whales Disappeared From The Salish Sea
item.description: Southern resident killer whales are usually abundant in the Salish Sea, but this year the whales disappeared, with no sightings in the last two months.

item.title: How Japan's Return To Commercial Whaling Might Help Whale Populations
item.description: For the first time in 31 years, Japan has returned to commercial whaling. What prompted the change and what does it mean for whale populations?

item.title: The 5 Biggest Threats To The World's Oceans - Awesome Ocean
item.description: These days, it's common knowledge that our oceans are under threat, but what exactly is causing the problems in our oceans and what can we do to help?

item.title: These Companies Have Found Innovative Ways To Turn Ocean Plastic Into Apparel
item.description: In an effort to combat plastic pollution in our oceans, these companies have developed innovative ways to turn ocean plastic into new products.

item.title: SeaWorld Orlando Offering Free Admission To Anyone Affected By Thomas Cook Collapse
item.description: In an unexpected turn, Thomas Cook announced they would be halting all operations effective immediately. SeaWorld Orlando offers free admission.

item.title: Let’s All Focus our Love of Whales and Dolphins on Protecting Them in the Wild…Together
item.description: The heart-tugging Sea of Shadows documentary details the compassionate effort to save the world’s most endangered marine mammal: vaquita porpoises.
